title: Orix Australia Corporation Ltd - proposed acquisition of Fleet Partners Pty Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced its decision not to oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The Australian market for car fleet leasing and management
body_sections.Competition analysis: Orix Australia and Fleet Partners both provide commercial vehicle fleet management and financing. A large number of competitors offer similar services, barriers to entry are likely to be low and customers are likely to have a high degree of countervailing power. Consequently, the acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition.
